mapper.insert: insert into notify_task(activity_id, team_id, task_id, task_type, notify_type, notify_url, notify_mq, notify_count, notify_status, parameter_json, create_time, update_time) values( #{activityId}, #{teamId}, #{taskId}, #{taskType}, #{notifyType}, #{notifyUrl}, #{notifyMQ}, #{notifyCount}, #{notifyStatus}, #{parameterJson}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select activity_id, team_id, task_id, task_type, notify_type, notify_url, notify_mq, notify_count, notify_status, parameter_json from notify_task where notify_status in (0, 2) and task_type = 1
